source: I'm not sure why, but man, am I tired...
target:
说起来，
我现在不知怎么的，特别困呀…

source:
Want to go for a drive with me, sometime?
If you want to, I mean...
Anyway, see you later.
target:
下次要不要去兜个风呢？
不过，也得看你愿不愿意啦。
那，下回见。

source:
I was up last night playing until
who-knows-when...

Oops! Sorry.
I'm talking to myself again.
Don't mind me.
target:
啊，不，没什么，这是我自己的事。
只是自言自语啦… 抱歉哦。

source:
If you've made it this far, then your
sense of rhythm has just got to be
a step above the rest!
target:
哎呀，都已经玩到这种地步了，
你的节奏感
肯定已经变得相当好了呢！

source:
So I guess that means you've
collected everything?
Impressive!
target:
哎呀呀，这可真是不得了，
居然全部完成了呀。
真有你的〜。

source:
Good work out there, my friend.
You've really earned a break.
See you around!
target:
你也累了吧？
稍微休息一下哦。
那，下回见。

source:
I'm so proud of you.
Moved to tears, even!
target:
我也高兴得
眼泪汪汪啦…

source:
I know it's not much of a gift,
but I've opened up more studio
songs for you.
target:
对了对了，
作为庆祝，虽然只是小小心意，
我帮你往录音室里添了些曲子。
天哪，主关卡和额外关卡
你完成了所有的完美挑战！

说起来，
咖啡已经上好啦。

source:
Me? I can make coffee, but...
need to work on the rest. Heh...
target: 我嘛，也就只会给人煮煮咖啡而已啦… 哈哈哈…

source:
Wait, you didn't order coffee?
Oh, this is from the person
sitting next to you. His treat.
target: 咦？你说你没点？ 啊，这个嘛，是旁边那位请的啦…

source:
He's not much for words, but
he's pretty friendly, and I guess
generous too.
target:
虽、虽然那位不太爱说话，
但大概也是想跟你交个朋友吧？

source:
Could you come back in a while?
I'm a bit busy.
By the way, I'm actually a dog.
target:
说起来，
其实啊，我是一只狗哦。

source:
You're a human, right? They say I'm
supposed to be your best friend.
We'd better get along then!
target:
客人你是人类吧？
虽然我是只狗，不过今后
也请继续跟我好好相处哦〜。

source:
I'm nine years old. Pretty spry
for my age, if I say so.
target:
算起来我已经 9 岁了，
也算一把年纪啦。

source:
Time goes by pretty fast when you're
as old as I am.
target:
哎呀呀，到了这个年纪，
时间过得可真快呢。

source:
You ever check out the drum
lessons in the bonus corner?
target:
说起来，奖励角里的击鼓课程，
你玩过吗？

source:
But once you start getting into it,
it's hard to stop.
target:
可一旦开始上课呀，
就还真有点停不下来呢〜。

source:
I guess no one can master the drums
in a day, though. We should take
our time with that stuff.
target:
不过嘛，乐器这种东西本来就不是一下子能变厉害的，
还是耐下心来，慢慢练下去吧…

source:
I've been taking lessons every week,
but I never seem to get any better.
target:
我每周会去上一次课，
不过怎么也不见
有多少长进呢。

source:
My teacher told me that I have a
bit of a problem pacing myself, that
I shouldn't push myself so much.
target:
老师也说过啦，
这种事本来就各有所好，
不用勉强自己。话虽如此——

source:
Welcome to the café.
This your first time here?
target:
欢迎光临。
你是第一次来这里吧？

source:
If there's anything I can
do to help, well, \0051\0015that's
what I'm here for.\0054\0018
target:
只要有我帮得上忙的地方，
我都会尽力的哦。

source:
I'm a little busy right now,
since I only just opened for the
day, but we'll talk more later.
target:
我现在正在准备点东西，
请你晚点再来哦。

source:
Feel free to come on by anytime you
find the games \0051\0015too hard to play \0054\0018or
you just need to take a break.
target:
这里嘛，就是所谓的咖啡店啦。
游戏打得不太顺的时候，
或者累了的时候，都可以来坐坐哦。

source:
So, when you're sad, what do
you do to cheer yourself up?
Me, I listen to music.
target:
说起来，难过的时候
你会做什么呢？
我呀，基本上就是听音乐呢。

source:
Maybe if I studied this stuff I'd know,
but I haven't!
Sorry! Heh.
target:
不过嘛，那些详细道理
我也不懂就是啦。哈哈哈。

source:
Dusting off a favorite record of mine
and taking a nostalgia trip...
That never fails to put me at ease.
target:
把那些挺老的唱片翻出来，
一边听一边回想当时的事，
心里就会慢慢放松下来。

source:
Music's weird like that.
Why does it hold such power
over our feelings?
target:
音乐真是很不可思议呢〜。
为什么它能那样
深深触动人的心呢。

source:
Give it some practice and you'll do
fine. I'm sure of it!
target:
多玩几次的话，
我想你会慢慢抓到诀窍的哦。

source:
I'm sure getting into the groove
of the music will be pretty
fun all its own.
target:
同时呢，
你也会越来越享受跟着音乐律动的感觉。

source:
Try not to get all worked up out
there. Make sure to have a good time.
target:
别太较劲啦，
开心玩就好…

source:
Is that so? My bad, then.
Guess that's why you shouldn't put
so much stock in a rumor.
target:
这样呀。
还跟你聊了些传闻，
真是失礼啦。

source:
Enjoy the games at your own pace,
alright? See you around.
target:
请继续享受游戏哦。
那回头见。

source:
You've probably heard of something
called an offbeat.
Do you know what that is?
target:
说起来，这个世界里常听人说的
“反拍”到底是什么，
你知道吗？

source:
Well, the offbeat is supposed to be
the exact point right inbetween each
of your claps.
target:
那每次拍手和拍手之间，
刚好正中间的那个时机，
听说就叫“反拍”。

source:
At least I think so. I'm not so great at
explaining this stuff, but I hope it helps.
See you around.
target:
嗯，大概就是这么回事啦。
讲得随随便便的，真不好意思哦。
那，下回见。

source:
I'm no expert myself, but I think
I've got the jist of it.
target:
不过嘛，我其实也没懂得那么多，
所以讲得可能不太靠谱哦。

source:
So, suppose you're clapping to
the beat of some music, right?
target:
比如说，
你跟着音乐很自然地拍手，对吧。

source:
...Sorry for yelling. I just got a little
excited.
target:
抱歉，刚才声音太大了。
我实在是太替你高兴了…

source:
Good luck on getting those Perfects!
See you around.
target:
Perfect 也要继续加油哦。
那回头见。

source:
By the way, have you ever gotten a
Superb rank on a game?
target:
说起来，
你有在游戏里拿过
“高水准”这个评价吗？

source:
Those medals let you unlock
some prizes. Sounds like it
would be worth your while.
target:
收集奖牌之后，
就能玩到各种各样的
奖励内容，所以要加油收集哦。

source:
But you probably already knew that,
right? Sorry if I bored you.
See you around.
target:
如果你本来就知道的话，
那我这番话可就有点无聊啦。
不好意思哦，那下回见。

source:
There are three ranks you can get:
Try Again, OK, and Superb.
target:
游戏成绩一共有
“再试一次吧”“平凡”“高水准”这三种哦。

source:
And, if you get a Superb,
you also get a medal.
target:
然后呢，只要拿到“高水准”，
就能得到奖牌哦。

source:
By the way, is a sense of rhythm any
different for humans?
target: 说起来呀，节奏感这种东西，对人类来说究竟意味着什么呢。

source:
Maybe I should try some of those
rhythm games myself...
target: 我也来试着玩玩游戏好了…

source:
Well, not like my rhythm couldn't do with
a bit of work, but...
target:
不过像我嘛，
平时倒也不怎么会特意去想这个啦。

source:
When your sense of rhythm
improves... that has to be
improves... that's gotta be
euphoric, huh?
target:
不过，节奏感变好了的话，
人应该也会稍微开心一点吧。

source:
Say, have you tried doing the
Rhythm Test again?
target:
说起来，
你最近有做“节奏感测试”吗？

source:
Counting those silent beats...
It's tricky, don't you think?
target:
要去数空拍这种事，
还真是挺难的呢〜。

source:
Well, let's take it one step at a time.
See you around.
target:
不过嘛，就慢慢来吧。
那，下回见。

source:
I've been giving it a spin lately.
Seems like 65 points is my limit.
target:
我偶尔也会去测，
不过，65 分左右就是我的极限啦……

source:
That second test gives me quite
a bit of trouble.
target:
那个第二项测试呀，
我怎么也做不好呢。

source:
I heard you can hold a conversation
with only rhythm.
target:
说起来，
你知道节奏也能拿来对话吗？

source:
At least that's what a customer
once told me.
Doesn't that sound fun?
target:
前阵子来店里的客人
告诉我这件事时，
我就觉得还挺有意思的，不是吗？

source:
But if you had percussive election
speeches or bongo arguments...
Expect a lot of noise. Hahaha!
target:
不过要是拿鼓来做竞选演说，
或者夫妻俩拿邦戈鼓吵架的话，
感觉会吵得不得了呢。哈哈哈。

source:
You can put words and meanings
behind different rhythms, like morse
code, and talk without speaking.
target:
就是把不同的节奏型
对应成话语和含义，
然后用来交流的样子哦。

source:
Like, bang out a message into one
of those taiko drums, and you could
communicate acres apart.
target:
听说他们会用响亮的鼓声
打出节奏，跟远处的人
交流哦。

source:
Ignore the camera's
zooms! Make the ball
zoom away! Don't blink!
Don't wipe your tears!
target:
别在意镜头缩放！
用心去击球！
不要依赖视觉！
大胆上吧～！

source: Can I have my ball back? I'll give you my last rice ball...

Ignore the camera's
zooms! Just believe
in yourself and
send the ball flying!
target:
别在意镜头缩放！
用心去击球！
不要依赖视觉！
眼泪也别擦啦～！

source: Next time, swing your bat somewhere else!
Guys, guys, look at what I've won!

Ignore the camera's
zooms! Make the ball
zoom away! Don't fall
behind! Let it fly!
target:
别在意镜头缩放！
用心去击球！
不要依赖视觉，把球打飞吧～！

source: A home run! I did it!
Failure is just the first step to success!
target: 或许失败乃成功之母呢！
研制出了超级厉害的药剂！！

source:
Look at the trio in their
Western outfits!
So cool! Dare we say
they look... snappy?
target:
原本穿着随意的他们
这次换上了
一身笔挺西装！
太帅了！！

source: I spent everything I had on this outfit!

The Bon Festival has
a modern-day style!
Clap along to this
new arrangement!
target:
这是现代版的
盂兰盆舞！
超带感哦！
耶！

source: Our new Bon Dance is a lot of fun!

Let's celebrate the
Japanese Bon Festival!
Clap along as they sing
their traditional song!
target:
跟着盂兰盆舞的
歌声，
“啪”地
拍手吧。

source: Oh... the quaint fizzle of a sparkler...
target: 手持烟花，总让人有点伤感呢。

source: That was so much fun! I can't wait for next year!

How are you feeling?
If something's on your
mind, feel free to
come and talk.
target:
最近状态怎么样？
要是有什么在意的事，

就来这里
聊一聊吧。

source:
These paragons of
dancing have mastered
their zero-G moves
and want to show off!
target:
代表宇宙的
舞者们！
那种利落动作
让人完全移不开眼呀！！

source: We cannot go on like THIS!
Is that the best you guys can do?
target: 你们就只有这点本事吗？
我们可是超级宇宙明星啊！！

source:
Collect medals to take
some Drum Lessons.
You could become
a master drummer!
target:
收集奖牌，
去上击鼓课程吧。
要变得更厉害哦！

source:
Collect medals to
unlock special
Endless Games!
Check them out!
target:
收集奖牌，
去挑战特别游戏吧！
有好几个哦。

source: Cough, cough... I think I blew it...
I am THE go-to fireworks guy!

See that ball bouncing
down the road?
You wouldn't want to
let it fall...would you?
target:
飞过来的圆球，
那可是好东西，
千万别漏接哦！
刚才这些配合还挺厉害呢！

source:
See that ball bouncing
down the road?
It's such a nice ball,
so don't let it fall!
target:
飞过来的圆球。
那真的是个
好东西哟～。
可别漏接哦！
你刚才已经相当努力了呢！

source:
Demons have put
the town in a panic!
Come on, Samurai--
slice them all!
target:
闪开 闪开，
那群家伙来了。
你身为武士，
格杀勿论！

source: Have you ever seen a sword this sharp?

The key to karate,
like all things, is rhythm.
Now, let us throw some
stuff for you to punch.
target:
向飞来的东西
按A键出拳！
很常见的游戏？
……也许吧。

source: I can always try again tomorrow...
Look at all this stuff I punched away!

Something's up with
the speed! Stay sharp
as we throw you some
more stuff to punch.
target:
向飞来的东西
按A键出拳！
不过，这速度
有点古怪哦。

source: What's the point of these speed changes, anyway!?

target: 嘛，先不管那些。来吃饭吧！

source: I think we've gone through everything!

We've increased the
speed! Do your best,
as we throw some more
stuff for you to punch.
target:
向飞来的东西 按A键出拳！
用干劲和气势把它们打飞吧！

source: The tournament didn't go so well...
I may not have won, but I did really well!
target: 比赛当天，感觉还挺不错的！

source: I won the tournament and took home the gold!

We're hosting a
concert! You've got
good rhythm, right?
So give it a try!
target:
要登台演出啦！
我觉得你的节奏感
已经很不错了，
放轻松就好～

source: The cleaner says... \"I know you can do it, keep at it!\"
The owner says... \"You've got great skills, you know!\"
target: 老板：“你啊，还挺有天分哦”

source: The producer says... \"You should play at our place, too!\"
target: 制作人：“要不要来我们这边试试？”

source:
There's a lonely girl
over there. Put your
flower power to good
use and cheer her up!
target:
你是一位魔法使。
给那个怕寂寞的
小姑娘送上一朵花吧。
这种我不要啦〜，好可怕呀〜！

source: These will look SO lovely when they bloom!
target: 要是能开出更多花，我会更开心呀〜。

source: Who could feel lonely with all these flowers?

Ready, march! Following
orders as a unit builds
your camaraderie.
Also, rhythm.
target:
现在开始行进。
擅自行动可是会
毁掉整个队伍的！
好好努力吧。
今天的任务，是打扫卫生哦♪

source: Mission success! We rescued the alien!

Ready, march!
This mission requires
finesse and technique,
so march your best!
target:
现在开始行进。
这次的动作
有点复杂！
好好努力吧。

source: I know we can perform better than that!

target: 我居然还拿到了这种奖励！！

source:
Ready, march!
This mission will require
quick marching, so stay
focused!
target:
现在开始行进。
这次需要非常迅速地做出判断。
好好努力吧。
啊，发现走失的小朋友了！

source: We rescued the lost puppy! Hooray!
target: 救到走失的小朋友啦！太好了！！

source:
What's better than a
stroll in the starlight?
How about a series of
jumps in the starlight?
target:
跟着音乐一起
尽情跳起来！
星星聚集，
你也奔向夜空…

source: Didn't see that hole in the dark!
target: 下一次可要再加把劲喔…

source: Nothing like a stroll at night.
target: 在夜空下散步，真开心呀。

source:
Time to jump in the
starlight again!
Keep a look out
for the electric fish.
target:
跟着音乐节拍
尽情跳起来！
遇到电击鱼
可要小心哦。

source: The night breeze feels so cool...
target: 夜晚的风吹起来可真舒服呀。

source: You made friends with the stars!
target: 你已经跟星星们成好朋友啦！

source:
An enemy is attacking
your lord! Block the
arrows with your sword
using  and !
target:
敌人来袭！
用十字键与 A 键迎战！
富士山！！

source: I cannot apologize enough, my lord!
Not a scratch! He said I'm admirable!

You know, my family's
ancestors came from
a long lineage of ninjas.
Cool, right?
target:
我爷爷的
爷爷的
爷爷啊，
可是忍者呢。

source: You can't give up! She's counting on you!
You are... strong. Don't give up yet.
You have proven your worth! You have our blessing...

Clap your hands in
order! You're the third
clapper. Keep an eye
on the other two!
target:
我们要依次拍手哦！
你排在第３个。
仔细看好前面两人！

source: You need to make it to more of our practice sessions...
target: 现在就满足，可能还早了点呢。
这三人组，配合也太默契啦！！

source:
Clap your hands in
order! You're the third
clapper. Watch out
for your fast friends!
target:
我们要依次拍手哦！
你排在第３个。
仔细看好前面两人再拍哦！

source: This is one nice space cruise!
I've discovered a new planet! Stellar!
target: 第一个到达未知星球！伟业！！

source:
Manage the  and 
paths at the same time
to keep those red rods
rolling! Simple enough?
target:
掌握十字键与A键同时按下的诀窍！
其实挺简单的。大概吧……

source: Producing these red rods is harder than I thought...
target: 这红色小东西，想实现大规模量产真是相当困难啊…

source: Still getting the hang of making these red rods.
target: 源源不断地生产红色小东西吧！

source: We've produced more red rods than we can stock!
target: 可真是一个劲儿地猛造红色小东西啊！！

source:
The left and right paths
have unique patterns!
Mind the tempo and
play to the polyrhythm!
target:
这就是左右分控！
跟着节奏完成操作，
来吧，复合节奏！
耶——！

source: We need to produce a whole lot more red rods...
target: 红色小东西，还得再多生产点才行…

source: Producing more red rods wouldn't hurt!
target: 再多一点 再多一点，继续生产红色小东西！

source: Red rod production is at an all time high!
target: 红色小东西要铺天盖地大规模量产咯！！

source:
Play a quiz where you
copy the host's pattern.
Seems simple, right?
Simple, but not easy.
target:
这是个很简单的问答，
只要猜中主持人
“敲了几下”
就可以啦。

source: I won the grand prize! A world tour!
target: 我居然赢得了环球旅行！

source:
The coolest rapping
duo has arrived! Their
hot rapping skills are
the talk of the town!
target:
一对超酷的搭档
登场啦！
火热的 Rap
让人兴奋到不行！

source: I think our tone was off.
target: 啧。总觉得状态不太对啊。

source: We're looking forward to hearing from you again!
target: 以后也请多多关照啦ー！！

source:
The RAPMEN have
some new rivals!
Don't be deceived
by their cute voices!
target:
那群饶舌男的
对手登场啦！
这可爱嗓音
简直让人神魂颠倒！

source: I know we can rap better than this!
target: 总觉得还是差了那么一点点…！

source: Yes, yes, YES! We've got it!
target: 对对对，就是这个就是这个啦ー！！耶ー咿！

source:
You are a rat. She is
a cat. You love cheese.
All the ingredients of a
tense encounter.
